title: How Sara Duterte-linked company got millions in Davao City Hall contracts

blocks.text: Rappler multimedia reporter Patrick Cruz breaks down his investigative report on a company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte — from Gencorp’s government contracts and the people linked to the company, including the Dutertes, to the legal issues surrounding the deals

MANILA, Philippines – Rappler’s investigation found that Gencorp Industries Inc., a company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte, bagged millions of pesos’ worth of government contracts for food and catering services from Davao City Hall, which is led by her brother, Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte.

Since Rappler published the report, these government deals have taken center stage at the impeachment trial of the Vice President in connection with allegations of unexplained wealth. Mayor Duterte has also been summoned by the impeachment court to testify on the government contracts.

In this video, multimedia reporter Patrick Cruz breaks down the investigation — from Gencorp’s government contracts and the people linked to the company, including the Dutertes, to the legal issues surrounding the deals.
